source.description: Document content transcribed and lightly condensed from the original four-page Google Docs resume. Current identity, contacts, employment headings and selected projects are joined from data/profile.json. Growth stages describe organizational development, not headcounts.

resume.summary: DevSecOps and platform engineering leader with 13+ years designing, building and scaling cloud-native platforms across AWS, Azure and GCP. Led DevOps transformations, Kubernetes and GitOps adoption, secure automated CI/CD, and cloud optimization delivering $1M+ in annual savings. Founding engineering member through the 0 to 1, 1 to 10 and 10 to 100 growth stages, connecting platform engineering, infrastructure as code, security and developer experience to reliability, automation and business outcomes.

groups.label: Platform & Developer Experience
bullets: Founding engineering member leading platform engineering, DevSecOps and cloud strategy through the 0 to 1, 1 to 10 and 10 to 100 growth stages.

Designed and implemented an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) for self-service infrastructure, standardized CI/CD and reusable services. Built internal CLI tooling and self-service workflows to standardize local development and improve Developer Experience (DevEx).

Built local-development, per-change k3s/k3k preview environments for an AI-agent workflow: capture an issue, apply a fix, raise a pull request, run automated tests, then human review and production rollout.
Architected AWS, Azure and GCP infrastructure with Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and Crossplane for cloud-agnostic provisioning; used Kamaji and Gardener for multi-tenant Kubernetes.
Authored reusable Terraform with peer-reviewed plans and blast-radius checks for production-critical changes; later adopted Crossplane XRDs for a Kubernetes-native, self-service infrastructure API.

groups.label: Reliability & Observability
bullets: Owned production Kubernetes reliability on Amazon EKS: on-call rotations, incident response, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and postmortems to closure.
Improved scalability and reliability with Cluster Autoscaler, Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA), capacity planning and Kubernetes platform optimization.
Built enterprise observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana and ClickHouse; added Datadog and Sentry for correlated logs, traces and errors in incident triage.
Established Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): SLIs, SLOs, runbooks and incident processes, with PagerDuty alerting and escalation for critical production systems.

groups.label: Delivery & Automation
bullets: Established organization-wide GitOps with Argo CD, ApplicationSets, App-of-Apps and Argo Rollouts, implementing canary, blue/green and progressive delivery for safer releases.
Built scalable GitHub Actions and GitLab CI platforms with self-hosted and Kubernetes regression runners; led the GitLab to GitHub migration to improve security, governance and developer experience.

Developed Python (Flask) and TypeScript platform automation and backend services to streamline workflows; championed AI-assisted development and automation to improve productivity, accelerate delivery and reduce manual effort.

groups.label: Cost & FinOps
bullets: Delivered $1M+ in annual cloud savings through FinOps, infrastructure optimization, workload rightsizing and migration of production workloads from AMD64 to ARM64.
Built a centralized AWS, Azure and GCP FinOps dashboard for real-time spend, utilization, forecasting and optimization visibility; established cloud governance standards.

groups.label: Security & Compliance
bullets: Served as Security Lead for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance through DevSecOps, infrastructure hardening, secure SDLC, automated vulnerability management and continuous VAPT.
Implemented continuous monitoring with GitHub Dependabot, AWS GuardDuty, AWS Inspector and Sprinto; integrated security findings into engineering workflows.
Designed Google SSO identity and access management; strengthened Cloudflare Zero Trust, DNS and edge security; deployed lightweight sites and pages on Cloudflare Workers.

groups.label: DevOps Transformation & Automation
bullets: Led the DevOps transformation from legacy monolithic deployments to CI/CD and automation; administered and optimized Jenkins, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, JFrog and GitHub for multiple engineering teams.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration with Puppet and Ansible; managed Nutanix infrastructure orchestrated through Morpheus.
Designed scalable Jenkins and Azure DevOps pipelines and reusable Jenkins Shared Libraries in Groovy to standardize delivery across teams.
Migrated source repositories from IBM RTC to GitHub and Azure Repos, improving collaboration and version control.
Implemented end-to-end Prometheus and Grafana monitoring; built Power BI dashboards with CI/CD metrics and pipeline insights for engineering leadership.
Developed Python and Flask automation services to streamline DevOps workflows, reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery.

groups.label: Deltatre
bullets: Led migration from .NET Framework to .NET Core and from monolithic services to microservices; deployed Docker and Kubernetes across self-hosted and Azure Kubernetes environments.
Built TFS/VSTS CI/CD pipelines for QA, UAT, staging and production Kubernetes clusters; standardized deployments with Helm charts and TFS build/release pipelines.
Implemented secure SSL certificate and secret management with Blackbox.

groups.label: Retail Project
bullets: Managed and optimized Jenkins and GoCD pipelines for reliable delivery; automated Windows application deployments on AWS and led the AWS to Azure migration with minimal downtime.
Built Terraform modules and Packer golden images to automate Azure provisioning and significantly reduce provisioning time.

groups.label: Comcast
bullets: Built and managed scalable Software-Defined Networking (SDN) environments for Versa Controllers.
Deployed and automated an OpenStack private cloud with Ansible; contributed to OpenStack and Ansible open-source projects.
Developed Python tools for SDN Controller deployment and end-to-end orchestration testing, applying DevOps to automated SDN infrastructure deployment.
Managed Ceph storage clusters, implemented High Availability for OpenStack, and deployed monitoring with Nagios, Zenoss, ELK Stack and Syslog.
